name: Banyan Tree Cabo Marques
insider_take: This clifftop sanctuary offers the most dramatic sunset views in Acapulco, where luxury villas cascade down volcanic rocks into the Pacific.
whats_special: Built into the rugged cliffs of Punta Diamante, each villa features a private infinity pool seemingly floating above the ocean. The resort sits on the same dramatic coastline where Acapulco's famous cliff divers have performed death-defying leaps for over 80 years. The spa incorporates ancient Mesoamerican healing rituals using local volcanic stones and indigenous herbs.
pro_tip: Book the Sunset Villa - it's positioned at the perfect angle to catch Acapulco's legendary green flash phenomenon that occurs just as the sun disappears into the Pacific horizon.
dont_miss: The resort's signature dining experience on the overwater pavilion during whale watching season (December-April), and the private beach accessible only by a dramatic clifftop elevator carved into the rock face.
pros: Stunning clifftop location overlooking Acapulco Bay
Luxury spa with signature Asian wellness treatments
Private villa accommodations with infinity pools
Multiple gourmet dining venues with ocean views
cons: Secluded hillside location requires transportation to downtown
